eyebrow: The objective changes at every stage
code:
# Stage 1 -- pretraining: predict the next token, no masking
loss = cross_entropy(logits[:, :-1], input_ids[:, 1:])

# Stage 2 -- SFT: same loss, but only on response tokens
loss = cross_entropy(logits[response_mask], labels[response_mask])

# Stage 3 -- alignment (DPO): optimize for preferred over rejected
loss = -log_sigmoid(beta * (logp_chosen - logp_rejected))
